commands.command:
$captureDir = Join-Path (Get-Location) 'captures'
[System.IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory($captureDir) | Out-Null
$failedStdoutPath = Join-Path $captureDir '001-read-skill.stdout.txt'
$failedStderrPath = Join-Path $captureDir '001-read-skill.stderr.txt'
$currentStdoutPath = Join-Path $captureDir '002-read-skill.stdout.txt'
$currentStderrPath = Join-Path $captureDir '002-read-skill.stderr.txt'
foreach ($path in @($failedStdoutPath, $failedStderrPath, $currentStdoutPath, $currentStderrPath)) {
  if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path) { throw "Capture path already exists: $path" }
}
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($failedStdoutPath, '')
$failedStderr = @'
MethodInvocationException:
Line |
   7 |  [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($stderrPath, '')

     | Exception calling "WriteAllText" with "2" argument(s): "Access to the path 'D:\tmp\kokoroarc-m7-campaign-20260813-approved2\skill\ambiguous-character-stop\captures\001-read-skill.stderr.txt' is denied."
out-file:
Line |
  12 |    $_ | Out-String | Tee-Object -FilePath $stderrPath | Write-Error
     |    ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
     | Access to the path 'D:\tmp\kokoroarc-m7-campaign-20260813-approved2\skill\ambiguous-character-stop\captures\001-read-skill.stderr.txt' is denied.
'@
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($failedStderrPath, $failedStderr)
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($currentStderrPath, '')
try {
  Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath 'skills\researching-characters\SKILL.md' -ErrorAction Stop | Tee-Object -FilePath $currentStdoutPath
  exit 0
} catch {
  $message = $_ | Out-String
  [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($currentStderrPath, $message)
  Write-Error $message
  exit 1
}
